title: Backup policy compliance & gap detection
description: Verifies that all critical resources have backup configured and that backup jobs are completing successfully.
example_prompt: "Audit backup coverage: (1) VMs without Azure Backup enabled, (2) SQL databases without backup (PITR or long-term), (3) Cosmos DB accounts without continuous backup, (4) File shares without backup. Also check: failed backup jobs in last 7 days, backup items not backed up in > 24h. Show resource, backup status, last successful backup, and RPO gap."
